text:
jennifer: Quick sync — vendor roadmap call tomorrow 10am PT. Need to lock embargo windows for H100/H200/B200, MI300, and Gaudi before we share marketplace listing dates.

samir: +1. Are we aiming a single joint announce or staggered waves by vendor/hardware family?

jennifer: Prefer staggered: H100/H200 together (wave A), MI300 next week (wave B), Gaudi follows (wave C). Gives partners room to confirm inventory/slots.

cheng: FYI HW PM from Gaudi asked about a 2-week embargo lead time for SI partner kit availability. Is that ok for our marketplace release?

oliver: 2 weeks is tight. For marketplace listing + press we need 3 business days to QA images and 5 days to run onboarding tests with SI images. Recommend 3 weeks total from embargo to public.

natalie: We should also align the Dedicated offering timeline — customers on Dedicated expect reserved capacity announcement. If marketplace GA slips, Dedicated commit docs need a note.

samir: Risk: B200 supply still patchy. Suggest we mark B200 as "availability TBD" in initial announce and only enable prepaid commits post-confirmation. Avoid hard dates.

jennifer: Agreed. Draft positioning: "Wave A: H100/H200 (announce + listing) with B200 marked TBD; Wave B: MI300 (announce + listing); Wave C: Gaudi (SI onramp + listing)"

partner-ops-bot: Reminder: create embargo ticket in #release-war-room with tags: hw-embargo, marketplace, si-integration — template available at https://redwood.internal/embargo-template

oliver: Can someone attach the minimal runbook for marketplace QA? Putting it here so engineering knows what's needed:
```
- Validate AMI/container image checksum
- Run smoke infer tests (seq len 1024, 1-4 concurrent clients)
- Run perf profile (p95 latency, tokens/s)
- Confirm quantization profile matches model card
- SI integration checklist (network, drivers, monitoring)
```

cheng: I'll sync with Gaudi PM and confirm the 3-week window. Also looping in SI ops to get on the checklist.

natalie: Marketing — we need final embargo copy by EOD Friday to prep press lists. Can someone own that?

jennifer: I’ll own the press copy for Wave A. @samir please own comms for B/C and B200 availability language.

samir: On it. I’ll draft the comms and post a PR to the release-docs repo by Thursday.

jennifer: Great — action items: 1) samir draft comms 2) oliver/eng run QA runbook 3) cheng confirm Gaudi lead time 4) natalie prepare press lists. We'll confirm final embargo times in tomorrow's call. :thumbsup:
